push.title: L 0-2 vs Cuc United | You: 6.6 (4th worst match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.6 isn't who you are. It's one night. Let's figure out what it's trying to teach us.

THE GOOD
+ 6 tackles attempted. You did the dirty work nobody claps for. Well, I'm clapping.
+ 2 key passes. You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ Misplaced passes 6, from 10 in your previous match. Small wins add up to big ones.

THE BAD
- Won 1 of 6 tackles (down from your usual 29%). My two cents: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. You'll thank me later.
- Your 4th worst match performance at 6.6. Chin up.
- In our wins you average 4 shots; here it was 1. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- 0-2 loss. We'll get 'em next time.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (7 of 13). Rough? That's sandpaper with an attitude. Lesson of the day: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.

Session plan: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Listen here, tuxedo_slide: A coach's whistle is just a fancy way of saying 'I care.'

Practice makes progress. - Coach Lasso
